dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin eyeing 140k while altcoins gear up to steal the show  
XRP moonboys dreaming of 20 bucks, good luck with that  
Dogecoin whales hoarding like it's 2021, here comes the pump  
Solana's DeFi flexing, Ethereum sweating  
August's gonna slap, hodlers - buckle up 🫡

Meme coins pumping, Layer2 choking, and Web3's just a buzzword soup.  
HODL or get REKT, degens - Dogecoin's laughing, Ethereum's crying.  
Vitalik's coding, Elon's trolling, and your airdrop's probably a scam.  
Welcome to crypto, where clowns run the circus. 🫠
